title: Panic and Heroics on FlyDubai Flight: ‘We Felt That This Was It’
partialText: A routine flight turned terrifying when a violent altercation broke out inside the cockpit and the aircraft dropped 17,000 feet in two minutes. Passengers subdued a knife-wielding attacker.

title: FlyDubai Flight to Israel Diverted After Clash Between Pilots: What We Know and Don’t Know
partialText: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel said one pilot stabbed another and may have attempted to crash the flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The plane landed in Saudi Arabia and all passengers were safe.

title: Trump’s Voluntary A.I. Policing Echoes What Biden Did. But Is It Enough Today?
partialText: President Trump’s plan to let A.I. companies police themselves comes amid mounting examples that they are failing to put safeguards on the technology.

title: Congress Set to Leave Washington for the Midterms With No A.I. Progress
partialText: Senate Democrats blocked a measure that would encourage, but not require, states to protect consumers from power rate hikes tied to data center growth, and had no limits on A.I. use or deployment.

title: Who Attended Trump’s AI Luncheon, and Who Sat Where
partialText: A seating chart of the meeting illustrated growing divisions within the artificial intelligence industry and how it is viewed by the White House.

title: Democrats Block Stock-Trading Bill, Denying the G.O.P. a Pre-Midterm Win
partialText: A Republican measure to limit, but not bar, congressional stock trading faltered in the Senate as Democrats thwarted a G.O.P. bid to show progress on an issue that has rankled voters.

title: Becerra and Hilton to Face Off in Televised California Governor Debate
partialText: Xavier Becerra, a Democrat who served in the Biden administration, will debate Steve Hilton, a Republican former talk show host, in what’s likely to be their only face-off before the election.

title: Andrea Shaw Says Vaccines Killed Her Twins. Authorities Say She Suffocated Them.
partialText: In a small Idaho town, a young mother is accused of killing her young twins. She blames the childhood vaccines they received.

title: Google Wants Hollywood to Stop Being So Afraid of Technology
partialText: 100 Zeros, a collaboration between Google and Range Media Partners, aims to give the tech giant a foothold in movies, TV and emerging forms of entertainment.

title: Fed’s Watchdog Finds No Misconduct or Illegal Activity in Costly Renovations
partialText: A new report by the Federal Reserve’s independent inspector general concluded that a nearly $2.5 billion construction project was poorly managed but made no referrals to the U.S. attorney general.

title: Hegseth Summons Troops for a ‘State of the Force’ Address
partialText: The gathering comes as the defense secretary is facing precarious times as the public face of the Trump administration’s unpopular war against Iran.

title: See How El Niño Is Washing Ashore in California
partialText: An enormous pulse of wave energy will soon reach Southern California and continue north, raising sea levels by half a foot and increasing threats from swells and tides.

title: Another Day of Pounding Rain Raises Flooding Fears in Texas
partialText: Texas had a dry summer, and rain on Wednesday could run off the arid ground like water on concrete.

title: Court Pauses Execution of Christa Pike, Tennessee’s Lone Woman on Death Row
partialText: Christa Pike tortured and murdered a classmate in 1995. She had been set to die on Wednesday, the first woman executed in the state in 200 years.

title: Legal Immigrants Lose Medicaid Coverage Under Trump’s Bill
partialText: Many immigrants without green cards will no longer be eligible for the health insurance program for low-income people.

title: A Hasidic Jew Protested Against an Israeli Flag. He May Be Deported.
partialText: Yehonatan Ovadia, who opposed the mounting of the flag in a small New York town, belongs to a Hasidic branch that is anti-Zionist. He is now in ICE custody.

title: D.A. in Cornell Case Hopes to Speak to Accuser as He Weighs New Evidence
partialText: District Attorney Matthew Van Houten said a woman’s report to the police in 2024 saying she had been raped at a fraternity did not support a criminal case. But he said he was now reaching out to her.

title: Chi Phi Says It Acted Quickly in 2024 to Expel Cornell Members Named in Sexual Assault Lawsuit
partialText: The national organization of the Chi Phi fraternity at the center of a Cornell University sexual assault lawsuit explained publicly for the first time how it handled the episode.

title: I Thought Things Had Gotten Better. The Cornell Case Breaks My Heart.
partialText: How could so little have changed?

title: America Used to Be Cool. What Happened?
partialText: The world order is changing. So is the United States’ place in it.

title: UK Believes Iran Played a Part in RAF Fairford Air Base Incident, Burnham Says
partialText: The British prime minister, Andy Burnham, said there were “strong indications” Iran played a part in the events at R.A.F. Fairford on Sunday, without providing details why.
